Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to gather the specific historical data requested by the user. Instead of retrieving the actual precipitation data for Seattle from 2020-2023 to calculate the probability, it only performed a search and displayed a list of search results (links to WeatherSpark). It did not extract the necessary data points (number of rainy days per year) required for the calculation, leading to the Orchestrator eventually hallucinating an incorrect final answer (20%) instead of the correct one (14.2%).
